source_item: NL bidding-zone day-ahead price 2018, annual mean (grid_price_nl_2018.csv, scripts/build_grid_price.py)
note: Grid EXPORT, not a supply: the value is the demand tech's cost_flow_in (a negative cost = revenue per kWh exported). System perspective: an exported kWh is worth the wholesale price; network costs are not refunded. Flat variant uses this mean; the day-ahead variant uses the hourly price (-day_ahead/1000), always at least 0.208 EUR/kWh below the import price, so buying to re-sell never pays. Member perspective (2027 feed-in 0.1259 - 0.0605 terugleverkosten) is in docs/tariffs_nl_2027.md.
